recommendedResearchRequests.instructions: Expand and clarify the ROCK CIRCUIT part of Music History Map. Current organization signal: rock, classic rock, glam, funk and broad band history. Prioritize documented music-related connections that help layout organization: associated genres, shared members, collaborations, influences, instruments and clear bridges to neighboring zones.
